scenes.headline:
CAN AI BUILD A
USEFUL DASHBOARD?
scenes.voiceText: Can AI turn a sheet of café orders into a dashboard I can actually use?

scenes.headline:
START WITH
A SMALL CSV.
scenes.voiceText: I started with fictional orders: date, product, quantity, and revenue.

scenes.headline:
ASK FOR THE
RIGHT CONTROLS.
scenes.voiceText: My prompt asked for revenue by product, a day filter, and totals that update when the filter changes.

scenes.headline:
LOAD THE CSV.
READ THE TOTAL.
scenes.voiceText: Across all twelve orders, revenue is four thousand four hundred and eighty rupees. Matcha is on top.

scenes.headline:
FILTER TO
SEPTEMBER SECOND.
scenes.voiceText: Select September second: revenue changes to two thousand three hundred and twenty rupees, and Cold Brew moves to the top.

scenes.headline:
NOW CHECK
THE MATH.
scenes.voiceText: I added the six source rows for that day. They total two thousand three hundred and twenty rupees, matching the dashboard.

scenes.headline:
BUILD. FILTER.
VERIFY.
scenes.voiceText: Try the starter prompt in the caption, and always check a number before sharing the result.
